about: Which simtabi-bot token each job may mint. A job not named here gets no token. Owners '*' means every org in dependabot/policy.json accounts.orgs; client accounts are refused whatever is written here.

dependabot-merge.why: Merge a policy-allowed Dependabot pull request once every check on its head is green. Workflows: write because GitHub refuses an app merge that changes .github/workflows/.

dependabot-reconcile.why: Push chore/dependabot-standard and open or refresh its pull request. dependabot.yml is not under .github/workflows/, so no workflows permission.

agent-kit-read.why: Check out the private generator the reconciler runs.
